items.name: 01-hero
items.prompt: Photorealistic interior photography, real estate photo, realistic proportions, no people, no text, no logos. A small modern Australian ensuite bathroom off a master bedroom: a frameless glass shower screen with a niche in the tiled wall, a wall-hung timber vanity with a single basin and a round mirror, large-format pale terrazzo-look floor tiles continuing into the shower, white vertical stacked wall tiles, a heated towel rail, a skylight bringing in daylight, a small plant. Bright, airy, realistic.
